title: Normalized geometric ring and module stalks of algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], using its fixed small affine etale model [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model] and tensor pullback [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], [def-sfb-space-derived-pullback-models]. For a geometric point $x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$, with $\Omega$ algebraically closed and in the original section universe [def-weil-size-convention], take the category of pointed affine etale neighbourhoods in the fixed small basis. A normalized stalk model is a colimit cocone of their actual regular-function rings, an additive module-stalk functor, and germ maps exhibiting every underlying additive group as the colimit of actual section groups. Scalar multiplication and maps of modules are required to agree on all germs with scalar multiplication and maps of sections. Such models exist and are determined up to the unique isomorphism preserving these colimit cocones. Define the stalk model by this universal property. For a morphism $a:X\to Y$, the ring map $\mathcal O_{Y,ax}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is the unique map agreeing with pullback of regular functions on every compatible pair of pointed charts. The unique natural pullback-stalk isomorphism sends $b\otimes\operatorname{germ}(m)$ to the germ of the local tensor $b\otimes m$ defined by the recorded adjunction unit. Transport this isomorphism and all germs through the specified small-model module equivalences. No flatness is required.

proof.text: For stalkModel_nonempty, use pointedEtale_small_cofiltered to make all pointed scheme charts cofiltered. Every pointed scheme chart has an affine open containing the image of its geometric lift. The lift factors through that open because Spec of a field has one point. View the open as an etale chart using schemeOpens and transfer it through the unit of equivSmallModel. This gives a weakly initial fully faithful functor from the chosen small affine pointed category to all pointed charts. Mathlib IsCofiltered.of_exists_of_isCofiltered_of_fullyFaithful gives cofilteredness of Neighbourhood. Its essential smallness follows from StructuredArrow.essentiallySmall and the small affine model.

Take the CommRingCat colimit of ringDiagram. Forgetting to RingCat preserves this filtered colimit. Restrict the original module presheaves along neighbourhoodChart using PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀ and apply PresheafOfModules.colimitFunctor to this specified ring colimit cocone. Its underlying additive groups are their section colimits. The constant-module functor is additive sectionwise, so colimitAdjunction.left_adjoint_additive makes the colimit functor additive. Use the colimit cocone maps as germs. ModuleColimit.map_apply proves map_germ, and ModuleColimit.smul_eq proves smul_germ. These fields form a StalkModel, proving stalkModel_nonempty without choosing any arbitrary existence witness for its data.

For stalk_additive, smallModuleEquivalence.functor is additive because its section maps preserve addition definitionally. Mathlib Equivalence.inverse_additive makes the inverse additive. Compose it with the additive modules field of the normalized stalk model.

The ring-map and pullback-stalk comparison parts remain the existing named obligations stalkMap_existsUnique and pullbackStalk_existsUnique, with the local refinement and tensor arguments in their unchanged docstrings. This partial stage-3 proof does not assert that those obligations have been closed.
